gloss: to burn out; to be burned out

definitions.gloss: to burn out; to burn away completely
definitions.explanation: Of a fire, candle, or building: to burn until nothing is left to burn.

definitions.gloss: to burn out; to be exhausted
definitions.explanation: To lose all energy and motivation after giving everything to a goal, or after long stress.

examples.japanese: ろうそくが⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き→燃え尽き：11105_moetsuki⟧た。

examples.english: Wait until the fire burns itself out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き→燃え尽き：11105_moetsuki⟧、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{残|のこ}らなかった→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The house burned to the ground overnight, and nothing was left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き→燃え尽き：11105_moetsuki⟧た。
examples.english: After the exams I was burned out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧した⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き→燃え尽き：11105_moetsuki⟧たように⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧しなくなった。
examples.english: After retiring, he stopped doing anything, as if he had burned out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧きた⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}で→後で：00920_atode⟧⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き→燃え尽き：11105_moetsuki⟧てしまった。
examples.english: She had poured everything into her work and burned out after a big project.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive; no transitive pair ({燃|も}やし⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ says "to burn up completely" transitively).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→燃え尽き症候群：08597_moetsukishoukougun⟧: burnout syndrome
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{燃|も}え{尽|つ}きる: to give absolutely everything (a famous line from the boxing manga あしたのジョー)
- ⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き→燃え尽き：11105_moetsuki⟧た⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after burning out

USAGE:
Sense 2 covers both the happy exhaustion of having given one's all and burnout from overwork; context decides which.
